requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments online easily, choosing a service and time.
The system needs to help manage barbers' schedules, allowing them to set availability and manage breaks.
Customers should be able to change or cancel appointments online without calling.
The system should send reminders to customers before their appointments.
There should be a 24-hour notice for cancellations.
The system should be user-friendly and not complicated.
